title: Boost Your Pilates Studio's Visibility with Google Business Profile | Pilates Education Institute

facts.fact: The article states that Google changed the name Google My Business (GMB) to Google Business Profile in 2021.
facts.quote: Google low-key changed the name to Google Business Profile in 2021, along with a few subtle feature changes.

facts.fact: The article recommends categorizing a Pilates studio's Google Business Profile as a Pilates studio, dance studio, or fitness facility, depending on the business model.
facts.quote: Depending on your overall business model, categorize your business correctly as a Pilates studio, dance studio, or fitness facility.

facts.fact: The article advises labeling each studio photo with a category and name for SEO purposes.
facts.quote: For optimal SEO, remember to label each photo with a category and name for the content.
